Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this game. The second T20I will be played on Thursday, 19th May. That game is set to begin at 4:30 pm IST (11:00 am GMT). Our coverage, though, will start in advance. Do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!
Craig Ervine has been named Player of the Match for his innings of 55.

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat first, Zimbabwe put on 153 runs on the board thanks to a brilliant captain's knock from Craig Ervine and a decent cameo from Sikandar Raza. The bowling from Namibia was good with Bernard Scholtz picking up two wickets and skipper Gerhard Erasmus too doing an economical job. Chasing a getable target, Namibia's innings got off to an ideal start but as the match got tighter, the lower order batters just found it tougher to score and Zimbabwe ended up winning the match.

The Zimbabwe bowlers deserve a round of applause and deservingly so. After their batters had put on a below-par total on the board, the opening bowlers too couldn't make inroads inside the Powerplay. However, the introduction of Milton Shumba was the turning point as he picked up three wickets and turned the game on its head. Tendai Chatara then closed out the game well and the hosts have the early lead in the series.

Namibia will be kicking themselves after that loss. They were cruising along at one point and with Divan la Cock set at the crease, they would not have expected to falter like this. After a strong showing with the ball, the openers put Namibia in command but a poor show from the middle order have caused them dearly.
What a start to the series we've had! Zimbabwe have snatched victory from the jaws of defeat to take a 1-0 lead in the five match series.
A length ball, around middle and leg. David Wiese tucks it towards deep square leg for a single. Zimbabwe win by 7 runs!
Well bowled! A yorker-length delivery, outside off. David Wiese drives it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Two taken! Fuller again, around middle and leg. David Wiese pushes it towards deep mid-wicket. They come back for the second run.
Back of a length, outside off, slower ball. Ruben Trumpelmann pulls it towards long on and hands the strike back to David Wiese.
Ruben Trumpelmann is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! A peach of a delivery! Tendai Chatara sends back Zane Green which means a new batter will be at the crease. A perfect yorker, outside off. Zane Green looks to squeeze this away, but he gets a faint edge back to the keeper. Regis Chakabva grabs it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Tendai Chatara

Commentary.Commentary: Very full, around off. David Wiese drives it through cover for a single.
Swing and a miss! Wide of off, fuller in length. Zane Green throws his bat at it but he misses. 15 off 6 now.
FOUR! Lovely shot! A shorter ball, around off. Zane Green upper cuts this over the keeper's head towards third man for a boundary.
Well bowled! A yorker this time, on middle. David Wiese knocks it towards long on for a single.
Width on offer now, another short ball. Zane Green cuts it towards deep cover. Only a single.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, a slower one now. David Wiese pulls this but the ball goes off the inner half of his bat towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Luke Jongwe digs it short, around middle. David Wiese pulls it towards deep square leg. The fielder there dives to his right and makes a good stop. Two taken!
Shorter ball, on middle. David Wiese pulls it towards deep square leg for another single. 24 needed off the last two overs.
On a length, around off. Zane Green pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Another shortish ball, outside off. David Wiese mistimes his pull shot towards long on. The fielder there collects the ball on a bounce. Another single!
Back of a length, outside off. Zane Green steers it down to third man. Single taken!
FOUR! Lovely shot! This will ease the pressure on Namibia! A short ball, around middle. Zane Green pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
On a length, angling in, around middle David Wiese taps it towards third man for a single.
Fuller this time, outside off. David Wiese drives it towards deep cover for a single. 33 needed off 18 balls now.
Shorter ball, outside off. Zane Green pushes it towards deep cover for a single.
David Wiese walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Zimbabwe strike once again at the right time! Milton Shumba, what a day he is having with the ball. He has got rid of Divan la Cock. An important wicket. Another shorter ball, around middle. Divan la Cock miscues his pull shot towards deep square leg. Luke Jongwe there takes a good low catch towards his left.
Commentary.Howout: c Luke Jongwe b Milton Shumba

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BOOM! Lovely shot! Fuller ball, that is in the slot, around off. Divan la Cock smashes it high over long on for a biggie.
Fuller now, around off. Zane Green reverse-sweeps this towards short third man for a single.
Around middle and leg, short ball. Divan la Cock pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off now, shortish ball. Divan la Cock punches it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
SIX! Bang! Divan la Cock continues his merry way! A shorter ball again, around middle and leg. Divan la Cock pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Zane Green pushes it off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Short now, on the pads. Divan la Cock works it away towards deep mid-wicket. Single taken!
Sikandar Raza pitches it up again, outside off. Zane Green leans and drives it towards long off for a single.
Darting it on the pads, fuller ball. Zane Green flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Wide of off, another short ball. Zane Green cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Outside off, shorter ball. Divan la Cock works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Another shorter ball, outside off. Zane Green punches it from within the crease towards cover for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Zane Green pushes it towards cover.
Zane Green is in at number 5.

OUT! STUMPED! This is smart bowling from Milton Shumba. Once again he provides the breakthrough. A good wicket for Zimbabwe at an important time. Milton Shumba sees Nicol Loftie-Eaton dancing down the pitch and serves it wide of off, shortish ball, spins away a tad. Nicol Loftie-Eaton looks to slash this but he fails to reach the ball. Regis Chakabva grabs the ball and whips the bails off.
Commentary.Howout: st Regis Chakabva b Milton Shumba

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, around middle. Divan la Cock knocks it towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a single. Fifty for Divan la Cock! It's been a solid innings so far from him. He will want to carry on till the end.
Shorter ball, around middle. Divan la Cock pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 59 runs needed off 36 balls now.
Fuller now, quicker, around middle and leg. Divan la Cock pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, spinning away, shorter ball. Nicol Loftie-Eaton steers it down to short third man and runs across to the other end.

Two byes! A shorter ball, outside off. Nicol Loftie-Eaton looks to reverse-sweep this but he misses. The keeper fails to grab it as well. The ball rolls towards third man and the batters sneak in two runs.
Quicker now, flatter ball, fuller. Divan la Cock guides it towards short third man for a single.
Wide of off, shortish ball. Nicol Loftie-Eaton reaches out to it and cuts it past point for a single.
Around middle and leg, shorter ball. Nicol Loftie-Eaton pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker now, spinning away from the left-hander. Nicol Loftie-Eaton looks to cut this away but he misses.
Outside off, flatter ball. Divan la Cock pushes it towards cover for a single.
SIX! Poor delivery and punished! Too short, spinning in, around middle. Divan la Cock swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a biggie.
Flatter, quicker, around middle. Divan la Cock defends it out.
Spinning in, back of a length. Divan la Cock knocks it towards mid on.
Shorter now, around middle. Divan la Cock pushes it off the back foot towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Nicol Loftie-Eaton presses forward and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Perfectly executed! A fuller ball, around middle. Nicol Loftie-Eaton gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps this past short third man for a boundary.
Maintains the same length, around middle. Divan la Cock tucks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Shortish again, outside off. Nicol Loftie-Eaton punches it through cover for a single this time.
Outside off, shorter ball. Nicol Loftie-Eaton pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Nicol Loftie-Eaton is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! A stunning catch and Gerhard Erasmus departs for a timid score. Milton Shumba strikes in his first over and he gets rid of Namibia's skipper. A fuller ball, loopy one as well, outside off. Gerhard Erasmus dances down the track and looks to go over cover, but the ball goes off the outer half towards point. Donald Tiripano runs backwards and takes a lovely catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Donald Tiripano b Milton Shumba

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Gerhard Erasmus pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Fuller, quicker, outside off. Gerhard Erasmus pushes it towards cover off the front foot.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Divan la Cock knocks it down to long on for a single.
Much fuller this time, outside off. Gerhard Erasmus presses forward and drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
A shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Gerhard Erasmus pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Milton Shumba comes into the attack.
Tidy over from Brandon Mavuta, 4 runs and a wicket off it. Flatter one, on off, kept out by la Cock. 83 needed now off 60 balls!
On off, pushed down to long off for a single.
On off and turning away, la Cock plays it with the spin and towards deep point for one more.
Around off, Erasmus goes onto the back foot and cuts it behind square on the off side for a run.
Flatter one, around off. This is cut away past point for a single.
Gerhard Erasmus walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brandon Mavuta changes ends and picks up the wicket that his team so desperately needed! This is tossed up on middle, Craig Williams gets down on one knee and looks to play the slog-sweep. Williams gets the height but nowhere near the distance, he would have liked. Wesley Madhevere takes a simple catch inside the cow corner fence and a sluggish innings from Williams comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Wesley Madhevere b Brandon Mavuta

Commentary.Commentary: Change of ends for Brandon Mavuta.
On off, driven through extra cover for a single.

What a brilliant piece of fielding in the deep! Short again from Raza and la Cock looks to pull it over the square leg fence this time. The fielder runs back a bit and pouches it but falls over. The fielder though manages to release the ball before tumbling over. Just a single taken.
SIX! Short and punished! Raza drags it down on middle and leg, Divan la Cock rocks back and muscles it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Angled into middle and leg, worked through wide mid on for one.
Floated up, very full and on middle. Williams can only defend it back towards the bowler.
On off, pushed out onto the off side.
Sikandar Raza comes into the attack.
Back of a length, around off. Willaims guides it down to third man for a single. These two just cruising along at the moment,
Back of a length, over middle. La Cock stays back and tucks it away towards mid-wicket for one more.
Full and straight, Williams jams it out towards long on and picks up yet another single.
Around the top of off, a mistimed drive off the back foot by la Cock towards wide mid off. Single taken.
Slower one, shorter and on the body. Williams just nudges it towards square leg and picks up a single.
Good fielding! Pitched up, on off. Williams with a solid punch but Jongwe does well on the followthrough to stop it.
Floated up, outside off. Craig Williams drives it hard towards extra cover where the fielder fumbles and allows the single.
Fuller delivery, around off and this is pushed towards covers.
On middle and leg, worked off the back foot through mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter in length, around middle. La Cock pulls it well in front of square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
WIDE! Now on the other side. Fuller and well outside off, wide called.
TWO WIDES! Shorter and spilled well down the leg side. Williams misses the pull and the keeper can't get to it either. Single taken.
On a length, close to the off stump. Williams keeps it out on the off side.
Shorter in length, on off. La Cock works it through wide mid on for a single.
It's time for some spin! Brandon Mavuta comes into the attack.
On the pads, clipped away to deep backward square leg for one. After the Powerplay, Namibia are 45/0! 109 now needed off 84 balls.
Shorter in length and outside off, just holding a bit in the pitch. Williams plays it towards backward point and rotates the strike.
This is pitched up, around off. Williams hits it hard but straight to the man at mid off.
Good bowling but the batters still able to steal a single. Jongwe bowls it into the pitch and on middle, la Cock dabs it down onto the deck and scampers through for one.
On middle and leg, flicked away towards mid-wicket for one more.
In the air but safe! This is full and on middle, Williams looks to turn it leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball loops up over the umpire's head and falls in no man's land.
Full and sliding down leg, Williams looks to flick but gets an inside edge towards backward square leg for a quick single.
Interesting to see Zimbabwe have not used any spinners yet. We did witness in the first innings the spinners getting a good amount of turn on this wicket.
A low full toss on off. Williams toe-ends it towards cover.
On a good length and angled into the body. La Cock tucks it past square leg and picks up a single.
Length this time, on off. Williams backs away and mistimes it towards mid off for a single.
WIDE! Tries to attack the pads but spills it way down the leg side. Wided.
Good piece of fielding. On middle, heaved towards mid-wicket where the fielder makes a good half-stop. The batters come back for the second.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and straight, Craig Williams swings freely through the line of the ball and hits it right back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
FOUR! Poor bowling! This is a half volley down the leg side, Divan la Cock just helps it into the fine leg fence.
Around off, pushed away to wide mid off for a single.
Peach! Tiripano bowls it in the channel around off and the ball angles in but holds its line at the last second. Williams is beaten past the outside edge.
FOUR! A tad short and there's width on offer. Craig Williams frees his arms and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
On a length, angling into middle. Williams pushes it back to the bowler.
Good fielding from Craig Ervine. Pitched up, on off. Williams hits through the line towards mid off but can't get it through.
Donald Tiripano comes into the attack. He replaces Tanaka Chivanga.
Chatara keeps it close to the off pole and la Cock just blocks it out.
Direct hit but NOT OUT says the umpire. Length again, on off, Williams just nudges it with soft hands onto the off side and sets off for the single. Excellent running once again.
On a good length, close to the off pole. La Cock hangs back and dabs it down towards backward point for one.
FOUR! Divan la Cock is off to a flier here. Around the top of off, quick hands from la Cock to cut it past point and pick up the boundary.
Length ball, nipping in from around off. La Cock blocks it off the back foot.
Risky single but they make it with ease. Tight line on off, Williams bunts it out on the off side and scampers through for one.
On middle, blocked out by la Cock.

SIX! Just to rub salt into the wounds, Divan la Cock takes full advantage of the Free hit. Short again, on the body. La Cock hangs deep and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Not the best of starts to Chivanga's international career.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Banged in short, around off. Divan la Cock tries to take it on and gets a top edge over the keeper's head and into the third man fencxe. No ball called for overstepping and a Free Hit will follow.
Goes fuller this time, Williams punches it towards mid on for a quick single.
On a good length, over middle. Williams hangs back and nudges it towards mid-wicket. Good tight bowling from Chivanga here.
Back of a length, around off. Williams pushes it off the back foot but can't get it through extra cover.
WIDE! A bit too straight from Chivanga, angling down leg and a wide is called.
NA length ball to start with from Chivanaga, around the top of off and Williams keeps it out on the off side.
Excellentn start from Tendai Chatara, just 2 runs off it. On off, la Cock pushes it towards covers. Also, Tanaka Chivanga to bowl from the opposite end.
WIDE! Trying to attack the pads but it is spilled down the leg side. Wide called.

Gem of a delivery from Chatara! Lands it on a length and outside off, the ball nips back in sharply and thuds into the pads of la Cock. The impact is outside off though and there is not much of an appeal either.
This is angled into off stump, la Cock hangs back and keeps it out.
Length ball, outside off and shaping away again. Divan la Cock makes a watchful leave.
Namibia are off the mark! This is around the hips and Williams just tucks it behind square on the leg side to get off the mark with a single.
Nice shape away to start with from Tendai Chatara. This is fuller and outside off, nipping away from the batter. Craig Williams leaves it alone.
